description: This source file defines the LoadShedQueueFlowController class, which implements load shedding flow control logic based on CPU usage and load shedding options within the Orleans framework. It includes factory methods to create flow controllers triggered by percentage of CPU or load shedding limits and a method to determine maximum queue additions based on current environment statistics.

classes.name: LoadShedQueueFlowController
classes.description: Implements queue flow control triggered by load shedding conditions, providing methods for controlling queue behavior based on load.

methods.name: CreateAsPercentOfLoadSheddingLimit
methods.description: Creates an instance of LoadShedQueueFlowController triggered at a specified percentage of the load shedding limit.

methods.name: CreateAsPercentageOfCPU
methods.description: Creates an instance of LoadShedQueueFlowController triggered when CPU usage reaches a specified limit.

methods.name: GetMaxAddCount
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of items that can be added to the queue based on current CPU load and load shedding settings.
